document.about: Hobart AM15 dishwasher specification sheet (8 pages). Page 8 sets its specifications as run-in paragraphs, each opening on a bold label (PUMP:, MOTOR:), with little space between them. Only the bold face declares a weight; the regular face declares none.

notes: Counting only the glyphs that declare a weight made a run-in label most of its line, so the first line of every paragraph was bold, became a section, and the rest of the paragraph followed apart from it.

checks.issue: The first line of the PUMP paragraph, its bold label and the plain text after it, was a level-5 section.
A label long enough to fill most of its line (MICROCOMPUTER CONTROL SYSTEM: Hobart) was a section by any majority of its glyphs.
A bold line ending on a plain figure (… 57 seconds: 38) that runs on to the next line was a section.
The PUMP paragraph was cut after its first line.

element.text: PUMP: With stainless steel pump and impeller, integral with motor assures alignment and quiet operation. Pump shaft seal with stainless steel parts and a carbon ceramic sealing interface. Easily removable impeller housing permits ease of inspection. Capacity 160 GPM. Pump is completely self-draining.

checks.issue: As above, for the paragraph whose label fills most of its first line.

element.text: MICROCOMPUTER CONTROL SYSTEM: Hobart microcomputer controls, assembled within water-resistant enclosure, provide built-in performance and reliability. The microcomputer control, relays and contactors are housed behind a stainless steel enclosure, hinged to provide easy access for servicing. The line voltage electrical components are completely wired with 105°C, 600V thermoplastic insulated wire with stranded conductors and routed through listed electrical conduit. Electrical components are wired with type ST cord. Line disconnect switch NOT furnished.
